name: realreturnengine
description: Compute 7-year expected real (after-inflation) and nominal returns, normalized fixed-income yields, and 100-year historical backtest accuracy (1928-2026) across Cash (3-Month US Treasury Bills), 10-Year US Treasury Bonds, Investment-Grade Corporate Bonds (Moody's Baa), and the S&P 500 (Post-1990 Baseline, 100-Year Baseline, Shiller 10Y Gov Bond CAPE / Excess CAPE Yield, and Standard Raw CAPE) on the Real Return Engine, rather than guessing expected returns in prose.
